usage: 구청 is the gu-level admin office; covers a whole district like 마포구, 강남구
get issued at the district office
for documents like 건축물대장 or 토지대장 you go to the 구청, while a simple 등본 is fine at the 동사무소
민원실 is the help-desk floor where you take a number and wait
관할 means the office responsible for your address; matters when filing complaints
examples: 사업자등록은 구청 말고 세무서에서 해요.
You register a business at the tax office, not the district office.
common mix-up; 구청 handles residency/buildings, 세무서 handles taxes
전입신고는 가까운 동사무소나 구청에서 하면 돼요.
You can file your move-in report at a nearby community office or the district office.
동사무소 is usually closer and enough for this
구청 홈페이지에서 미리 예약하고 갔어요.
I booked online on the district office website before going.
many 구청 now take online reservations to cut waiting
nuance: 구청 is the borough-level government office serving an entire 구 (district), one tier above the neighborhood 동사무소. As a resident you mainly visit it for ID documents, building/property paperwork, and parking or noise complaints. For everyday certificates, the closer 동사무소 is usually enough.
mistakes: Confusing 구청 with 시청: 시청 (city hall) governs the whole city, 구청 governs one district within it.
Going to 구청 for taxes; income and business taxes are handled at the 세무서, not the 구청.

usage: 동사무소 is the smallest admin office, one per 동 (neighborhood)
get (a document) issued at the dong office
떼다 is the natural verb for pulling a certificate like 주민등록등본
most residents go to whichever 동사무소 is closest
examples: 이사하면 14일 안에 동사무소에서 전입신고 하세요.
When you move, file your move-in report at the dong office within 14 days.
전입신고 is legally required; late filing can mean a small fine
요즘은 동사무소를 행정복지센터라고 불러요.
These days the dong office is officially called an administrative welfare center.
the modern name is 행정복지센터, but everyone still says 동사무소
등본은 동사무소 무인발급기에서 바로 뽑았어요.
I printed my residence certificate right from the unmanned kiosk at the dong office.
the self-service kiosk avoids waiting in line
nuance: 동사무소 is the neighborhood-level office where residents handle the most common errands: move-in reports, residence and family certificates, and ID-related paperwork. Its official name changed to 주민센터 and then 행정복지센터, but spoken Korean still overwhelmingly uses 동사무소. It is almost always closer and faster than the district 구청.
mistakes: Assuming the kiosk needs a fee for everything; a 등본 print is cheap or free, but you still need your ID to use it.
Saying 동사무소 for the whole district; it only covers one 동 (neighborhood), not the entire 구.

usage: go to the public health center
보건소 is a government-run clinic, one per district
get tested at the health center
common for free or low-cost health screenings and STI tests
flu and travel shots are often cheaper here than at a hospital
the health center for your area
관할 means the one assigned to your district; matters for some free programs
examples: 독감 예방접종은 동네 보건소가 병원보다 훨씬 싸요.
The flu shot is much cheaper at the local health center than at a hospital.
a big practical reason residents use 보건소
보건소에서 무료로 건강검진을 받을 수 있어요.
You can get a free health check-up at the public health center.
eligibility varies, but basic screenings are often free
해외여행 전에 보건소에서 필요한 주사를 맞았어요.
Before traveling abroad I got the necessary shots at the health center.
보건소 handles travel vaccines like 황열, hepatitis
nuance: 보건소 is the district-run public health center, offering vaccinations, health screenings, and basic medical services at little or no cost. For a budget-conscious resident, it is the go-to for flu shots, travel vaccines, and routine check-ups that would be pricier at a private 병원. It is a public office, so it keeps standard weekday hours.
mistakes: Treating 보건소 like a regular hospital for emergencies; for urgent care you still go to a 병원 or 응급실.
Confusing 보건소 (public health center) with 보건복지부 (the national Health Ministry); the latter is not a place you visit for shots.

usage: 세무서 is the local branch of the national tax service (국세청)
file (a return) at the tax office
신고 is the word for declaring income or registering a business
your 관할 세무서 is decided by your business or home address
직원 can answer questions about filing in person
examples: 프리랜서는 5월에 세무서에 종합소득세를 신고해야 해요.
Freelancers must file comprehensive income tax at the tax office in May.
May is 종합소득세 season; very relevant for freelancers
사업자등록증은 세무서에서 발급받았어요.
I got my business registration certificate from the tax office.
starting any business or side gig requires 사업자등록 at the 세무서
요즘은 세무서에 안 가도 홈택스에서 신고할 수 있어요.
These days you can file on Hometax without going to the tax office.
홈택스 is the online tax portal that replaces most visits
nuance: 세무서 is the local tax office, the branch of the national tax service where you register a business and file income tax. It matters most to freelancers and small-business owners, especially during the May 종합소득세 season. Many tasks now happen online via 홈택스, but in-person help at the 세무서 is still available for complex cases.
mistakes: Confusing 세무서 (tax office) with 세무사 (a private tax accountant you hire); the office is government, the 세무사 is a paid professional.
Going to the 구청 to register a business or file taxes; that is the 세무서's job.

usage: 파출소 is the small neighborhood police station for minor matters
for small incidents, lost items, or disputes
they are scattered through neighborhoods, so one is usually close
the officer at the police box
경찰 here means the on-duty patrol officer
examples: 지갑을 주워서 근처 파출소에 맡겼어요.
I found a wallet and handed it in at the nearby police box.
lost-and-found is a typical 파출소 errand
밤에 취객이 시끄러워서 파출소에 전화했어요.
A drunk person was being loud at night, so I called the police box.
for non-emergency neighborhood trouble
요즘은 파출소를 지구대로 합친 곳이 많아요.
These days many police boxes have been merged into larger substations.
지구대 is the newer, larger unit replacing some 파출소
nuance: 파출소 is the small neighborhood police post you go to for minor incidents, lost-and-found, and local disputes, as opposed to the larger 경찰서 that handles serious crime. For a true emergency you still dial 112, but for everyday matters the nearby 파출소 is the practical first stop. Many have been consolidated into bigger 지구대 units.
mistakes: Going to the 파출소 for a real emergency instead of calling 112; the phone line dispatches help faster.
Confusing 파출소 (small police box) with 경찰서 (the district police station that handles formal cases).

usage: 법원 is the courthouse where legal cases are heard
신청 covers filings like 지급명령 or 임차권등기
판결 is the formal decision a judge issues
which 법원 hears your case depends on the address or contract
examples: 집주인이 보증금을 안 줘서 법원에 소송을 냈어요.
The landlord wouldn't return the deposit, so I filed a lawsuit in court.
deposit (보증금) disputes are a common reason renters use the 법원
소액 사건은 법원에서 비교적 빨리 처리돼요.
Small-claims cases are handled relatively quickly by the court.
소액심판 is a simpler track for smaller amounts
법원에서 보내온 서류는 꼭 기한 안에 답해야 해요.
You must respond to documents sent by the court within the deadline.
ignoring a 법원 notice can lead to losing by default
nuance: 법원 is the courthouse, where civil and criminal cases are decided by judges. For a resident the most likely contact is a civil matter, such as recovering an unreturned jeonse or monthly-rent deposit through a small-claims filing. Court documents carry strict deadlines, so any letter from the 법원 should be acted on promptly.
mistakes: Confusing 법원 (court) with 경찰서 (police station); the police investigate, the court rules.
Ignoring a deadline on a 법원 notice; missing it can mean an automatic loss in your case.

usage: 체육관 is an indoor sports hall, often public and run by the district
구민 means district residents; these public gyms are cheap to use
groups rent court time for futsal, badminton, basketball
실내 marks it as covered, usable year-round
examples: 구청에서 운영하는 체육관이라 이용료가 정말 싸요.
It's a gym run by the district office, so the fee is really cheap.
public 체육관 are far cheaper than private 헬스장
주말마다 친구들이랑 체육관에서 배드민턴을 쳐요.
Every weekend I play badminton with friends at the sports hall.
court sports are the typical use of a 체육관
체육관 수영장은 미리 예약해야 자리가 있어요.
You have to book the gym's pool in advance to get a spot.
popular public facilities fill up fast
nuance: 체육관 is an indoor gymnasium or sports hall, often a public facility run by the 구청 or city, used for court sports, swimming, and group exercise. For residents it is a budget-friendly alternative to a private 헬스장, though popular time slots require booking. Note it means the sports-hall building, not a personal weights gym.
mistakes: Using 체육관 for a private weights gym; that is usually called a 헬스장 or 피트니스.
Assuming you can just walk in; many public 체육관 require reservations or a usage fee for facilities like the pool.

usage: go to the public help desk
민원실 is the front-desk office for residents' requests inside a public building
민원 is any formal request or complaint a citizen makes
창구 is the counter where you're served after taking a number
처리 means the office acting on your 민원
examples: 서류 발급은 1층 민원실에서 번호표 뽑고 기다리세요.
For document issuance, take a number at the first-floor help desk and wait.
번호표 (number ticket) system is standard at 민원실
주차 문제는 구청 민원실에 민원을 넣었어요.
I filed a complaint about parking with the district office help desk.
민원 covers complaints, not just document requests
온라인으로 안 되는 건 직접 민원실에 가야 해요.
For things you can't do online, you have to go to the help desk in person.
some requests still need an in-person visit
nuance: 민원실 is the public-service desk inside a government building (구청, 동사무소, etc.) where residents request documents or file complaints. The word 민원 itself means a citizen's formal request or grievance, so 민원실 is literally the room that handles them. Expect a take-a-number 번호표 system and a 창구 (service window).
mistakes: Treating 민원실 as a specific building; it is a desk or office located inside a larger government building.
Using 민원 only for complaints; it also covers neutral requests like getting a certificate issued.

usage: 등기소 handles official property and corporate registrations
등기부등본 shows a property's ownership and any liens
등기 is the legal record of who owns a property
which 등기소 you use depends on the property's location
examples: 전세 계약 전에 등기부등본을 꼭 확인하세요.
Be sure to check the property register before signing a jeonse contract.
checking 등기부등본 reveals hidden mortgages before you pay a deposit
요즘은 등기소에 안 가도 인터넷등기소에서 열람할 수 있어요.
These days you can view records on the internet registry without going to the office.
인터넷등기소 is the online portal for 등기 records
전입신고 후에 확정일자를 받아 두는 게 안전해요.
After your move-in report, it's safer to get a fixed date stamped.
확정일자 plus 전입신고 protects your deposit priority
nuance: 등기소 is the registry office that keeps official records of property ownership and company registrations. Its most practical product for a renter is the 등기부등본, the property register you must check before signing a jeonse or wolse contract to confirm the landlord's ownership and spot existing loans. Most people now access these records online via 인터넷등기소.
mistakes: Skipping the 등기부등본 check before a lease; it is the key way to spot a property already heavily mortgaged.
Confusing 등기소 (property registry) with 등기우편 (registered mail at the post office); they are unrelated despite sharing 등기.

usage: 출입국사무소 handles visas and foreign-resident registration
you book a slot online via 하이코리아 before visiting
체류 연장 is renewing the period you're allowed to stay
the immigration office for your area
your 관할 office is set by where you live
examples: 외국인등록증은 출입국사무소에서 발급받아요.
You get your foreign resident card at the immigration office.
the ARC (외국인등록증) is issued here, essential for living in Korea
비자 연장은 출입국사무소에 미리 예약하고 가야 해요.
For a visa extension you must book an appointment at the immigration office in advance.
walk-ins are hard; 하이코리아 reservations are expected
주소가 바뀌면 출입국사무소에도 신고해야 해요.
If your address changes you must report it to the immigration office too.
체류지 변경 신고 is required of foreign residents
nuance: 출입국사무소 is the immigration office, the single most important government office for a foreign resident: it issues the 외국인등록증 (ARC), processes visa extensions and changes, and records address updates. Visits almost always require an online reservation through 하이코리아, since walk-in capacity is limited. Its formal name is 출입국·외국인청, but 출입국사무소 is the everyday term.
mistakes: Reporting an address change only at the 동사무소; foreign residents must also report it to the 출입국사무소.
Showing up without a reservation; most immigration offices now require booking and may turn away walk-ins.

usage: 우편함 is the box at your building where mail is delivered
꽂히다 describes mail tucked into the slot
apartment lobbies have a wall of 공동 우편함, one per unit
many building 우편함 have a small dial lock
examples: 고지서가 우편함에 며칠째 그대로 있었어요.
The bill had been sitting in the mailbox for several days.
고지서 (bills) and official notices arrive by mail
등기우편은 우편함에 안 넣고 직접 받아야 해요.
Registered mail isn't left in the mailbox; you have to receive it in person.
등기 requires a signature, unlike regular mail
관리비 고지서는 매달 우편함으로 와요.
The maintenance-fee bill comes to the mailbox every month.
관리비 notices are a routine piece of resident mail
nuance: 우편함 is the mailbox where letters and official notices are delivered, typically a locked unit in an apartment lobby. As a resident you should check it regularly, since bills (고지서), tax notices, and government letters arrive this way and often carry deadlines. Note that registered mail (등기우편) is not left here but handed over in person against a signature.
mistakes: Confusing 우편함 (your delivery mailbox) with 우체통 (the red public postbox you drop outgoing letters into).
Expecting 등기우편 in the 우편함; registered items require an in-person handoff or a redelivery.

usage: 관공서 is the umbrella term for any public office (구청, 세무서, etc.)
usually weekdays 9 to 6, closed weekends and holidays
휴무 on public holidays; plan errands around them
official paperwork from a public office
documents issued or required by a 관공서
examples: 관공서는 평일에만 열어서 점심시간에 다녀와요.
Government offices are only open on weekdays, so I run over during my lunch break.
the weekday-only schedule is a real planning constraint
공휴일에는 관공서가 다 문을 닫아요.
On public holidays all government offices are closed.
공휴일 closures catch newcomers off guard
은행이랑 관공서 일은 오전에 미리 끝내는 게 좋아요.
It's best to finish bank and government-office errands in the morning.
lines grow in the afternoon
nuance: 관공서 is the general term covering all government and public offices, the kind of place you go for official paperwork, from the 구청 to the 세무서. The practical thing to remember is their schedule: weekdays only, standard daytime hours, and closed on public holidays. Newcomers often plan an errand only to find the 관공서 shut for a holiday.
mistakes: Assuming 관공서 keep evening or weekend hours like banks' ATMs; they generally close at 6 on weekdays.
Trying to visit on a 공휴일 (public holiday); nearly all 관공서 are closed and you'll need to use online services instead.
